description: Search the Project Gutenberg catalog of 78,000+ public-domain books. Matches title and author name with query words; filters by topic (subject or bookshelf keyword), language, author lifespan, or a specific list of Gutenberg IDs. Default popularity ordering uses downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot. Returns IDs, titles, authors, languages, subjects, counts, and is_readable — use gutenberg_get_book for full metadata.

author_year_end.description: Include only books with at least one author alive on or before this year. Example: author_year_start=1800 with author_year_end=1899 returns books with 19th-century authors.

author_year_start.description: Include only books with at least one author alive on or after this year (positive = CE, negative = BCE). Combine with author_year_end for a range.

ids.description: Narrow results to specific Gutenberg ID numbers. Other filters still apply. Useful for batch pre-fetching known IDs; use gutenberg_get_book for single-ID lookups.

languages.description: Filter to books in any of these two-character ISO 639-1 language codes. Example: ["en"] for English, ["fr", "de"] for French or German.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (1-indexed). Each page returns up to 32 books. Use totalCount to determine total pages.

query.description: Words to match against book titles and author names (case-insensitive, space-separated). Example: "dickens expectations" matches Great Expectations by Charles Dickens.

sort.description: Result ordering. "popular" (default) sorts by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, descending. "ascending" and "descending" sort by Gutenberg ID number.

topic.description: Case-insensitive phrase to match against subjects and bookshelves. Example: "detective" returns books on the "Detective and Mystery Stories" bookshelf. Separate from query — topic searches categorization metadata, not title/author.

name: gutenberg_search_books

books.description: Matching books, ordered by the sort parameter.

birth_year.description: Author birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Author death year, or null if unknown or still living.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot.

has_plain_text.description: True for Text records with UTF-8 plain text; HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

id.description: Gutenberg ID — pass to gutenberg_get_book for the full record or gutenberg_get_text to read the book.

is_readable.description: True for non-Sound records with UTF-8 plain text or HTML supported by gutenberg_get_text.

languages.description: Two-character language codes for this edition.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_results`: The query matched no books in the catalog. `page_out_of_range`: The requested page number is past the last page of results for this query. `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer within the time this server allows for one search. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True if there are additional pages of results.

totalCount.description: Total number of books matching the query across all pages.

title: Search Gutenberg Books
